_comment: Gem tier on purpose. The Sequencer is the only route to a spawn egg, and a spawn egg is the
only route to a working spawner, so this recipe is the second gate on that whole chain -
the first being the Broken Spawner the cage recipe consumes, 1 in 2000 depths pulls.
That last clause read 'four Broken Spawners out of the depths' until 2026-09-07, describing a
world where teardown taught the sheet. #390 ended teardown teaching anything and the sheet is
bought from the Buy Terminal now, so for a while the sentence named a route that did not exist.
